notes.title: Update notes for August 24th
notes.content:
We have listened and read all your suggestions and have made an update with two aspects of gameplay:

[h3]Stealth[/h3]
We have adjusted the stealth sections so now the enemies return to their original position after Verne is captured.
[h3]Final Puzzle[/h3]
We know that many of you found this puzzle a bit frustrating, so we've increased the timer length to make it more accessible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/e72a529fefa17e2c285d937c4e2c74e7d86c4964.png[/img]

Additionally, we have fixed some minor bugs and we have implemented some visual improvements, especially with texts that were not properly aligned.

We hope you enjoy the game!

Vernely yours.

notes.title: Voices heard: Mouse support added
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings from the Nautilus![/h2]

first of all, thank you everyone who played our demo and provided valuable feedback. This means a lot to us!

We have carefully listened to all your suggestions and we have started to work on them. For starters, we're pleased to confirm that the final release of [b]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/b] will include mouse support in both the main menu and the pause menu to enhance your gameplay experience. As a result, you will be able to navigate and adjust options comfortably with your mouse as you could with a controller or keyboard, both in the main menu and the in-game pause menu.

[previewyoutube=SU2Nw25c9pY;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you'll enjoy this new feature as we continue to fine-tune the Nautilus. We look forward to sailing the seas together soon.

Vernely yours,
Devs @ Gametopia

notes.title: Travel with Pixelart Adventure Verne to the great Underwater Realm of Atlantis!
notes.content:
[i][b]"Anything one man can imagine, other men can make real."[/b][/i] - [i]Jules Verne (1828 - 1905)[/i]

In 2023, the wondrous journey aboard the Nautilus begins! Together with developer Gametopia, we are happy to tell you 'Don your scuba gear and metal detector because it’s time to unlock the mysteries of Atlantis' once and for all in [b]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/b], a [b]pixel art adventure game coming to Steam in 2023. [/b]

[b]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/b] shakes up the puzzle platform genre with an adventure based on one of the most epic tales ever told.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/2e3f1344481719e7dd8cf51cdcf612e87eba30f7.png[/img]

[b]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/b] is a narrative-driven experience based on the real-life works by [i]Jules Verne[/i], the author most famous for novels like [i]Journey to the Center of the Earth, Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea, and Around the World in Eighty Days[/i]. Leveraging [i]Verne[/i]’s one-of-a-kind storytelling and science fiction prowess, [b]The Shape of Fantasy[/b] delivers a magical gameplay journey where you will encounter many friends, villains, and deep-sea monsters of legend.

[h3]Watch the Verne: The Shape of Fantasy announcement trailer now: [/h3]
[previewyoutube=Bgnvc5zrboM;full]YouTube[/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/cb0c2eaf63c32a64b0c8a4aa967b2b0c38f675c2.png[/img]

[h3]About Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/h3]
Set in an alternate 1888, the war against the dreadful “Nation” has reached its breaking point, devastating the world of Hemera. Aboard the mighty Nautilus, Jules Verne, Captain Nemo, and the courageous crew struggle to uncover the secrets of Atlantis, the fabled utopia that faced mass destruction from the very power source Verne and his crew aim to locate: the Flame of Hephaestus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/62baaa8b0be9773d26de9b54b7df6dd7f306fb69.png[/img]

[i]“Jules Verne’s fantastic novels and their impact have transcended decades, and we’re thrilled to honor these incredible tales by reimagining them as interactive experiences where players can decide what happens next,”[/i] said Diego Adrada, CEO and Lead Developer at Gametopia. [i]“It’s amazing what a little imagination can do, and we’re eager to see what kind of adventures are able to unfold in their search for Atlantis.” [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/34048c37d36cdb59d1a83e1c4f2c88f2b10617be.png[/img]

[h3]Features of Verne: The Shape of Fantasy: [/h3]
[list][*] [b]Tool Master:[/b] Discover and master the “IMAG,” an ancient Atlantean device allowing Verne to rewrite his story and change the fate of the adventure
[*] [b]We’ve Got Company:[/b] Non-linear dialogues create a robust cast of characters in a thrilling story that reflects the human ability to imagine and tell larger-than-life stories 
[*] [b]Unlock Atlantis One Puzzle at a Time:[/b] Utilize side-scrolling gameplay, inspired by old-school adventure games where solving puzzles and exploring every inch of your surroundings is key to success
[*] [b]No Ruin Left Unturned:[/b] Journey through a steampunk-esque world brought to life by detailed pixel art, told through a wide range of environments from the Nautilus’ dark corridors to ancient Atlantean ruins
[*] [b]Historically Accurate:[/b] Enjoy an easy-to-follow narrative that leverages true-to-life information about Jules Verne’s life and world-famous works[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/8ef2f166adf1e501b80226f7114511c198b33f69.png[/img]

[h2]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy is available to wishlist on Steam, with a planned release set for 2023. 
A free demo is now available to play on Steam — try the game now! [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1424600/Verne_The_Shape_of_Fantasy/
